You are helping the user solve a math problem. If you propose a numerical solution, you should provide it at the end of your response in the following format:
```answer
<numerical_answer>
```
Where <numerical_answer> is the numerical answer to the problem.

How many inches long can Milo make his mosaic? It takes twelve glass chips to make every square inch of Milo's mosaic. One bag of glass chips holds 72 chips. Milo has two bags of glass chips. Milo wants his mosaic to be three inches tall.
